subject: Urology
content: Urology focuses on diseases and surgical conditions of the urinary tract and the male reproductive system.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Urology
content: The urinary system includes the kidneys, ureters, bladder, and urethra and removes wastes while helping regulate fluid and electrolyte balance.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Urology
content: The male reproductive system includes the testes, epididymides, vas deferens, prostate, seminal vesicles, penis, and associated structures.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Urology
content: The urinary bladder stores urine and contracts during urination to expel urine through the urethra.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Urology
content: Urinary incontinence is loss of bladder control that causes involuntary leakage of urine and has several possible causes and patterns.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Urology
content: Overactive bladder is characterized by urinary urgency, often with increased frequency and nighttime urination, with or without urgency incontinence.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Urology
content: Urinary retention is difficulty emptying the bladder completely and can be acute or chronic.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Urology
content: Benign prostatic hyperplasia is noncancerous enlargement of the prostate that can compress the urethra and cause lower urinary tract symptoms.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Urology
content: Lower urinary tract symptoms may include weak stream, hesitancy, urgency, frequency, nocturia, incomplete emptying, and intermittency.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Urology
content: A urinary tract infection is an infection involving part of the urinary system and commonly affects the bladder or urethra.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Urology
content: Pyelonephritis is a kidney infection that can occur when bacteria spread upward from the lower urinary tract.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Urology
content: Recurrent urinary tract infections refer to repeated infections and may require evaluation for behavioral, anatomical, functional, or other contributing factors.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Urology
content: Kidney stones are hard deposits formed from substances in urine and can obstruct urinary flow and cause pain.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Urology
content: A stone passing into the ureter can obstruct urine flow and cause severe flank or abdominal pain, often with nausea or hematuria.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Urology
content: Kidney stones can contain different minerals, with calcium-based stones being common and other types including uric acid, struvite, and cystine stones.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Urology
content: Adequate fluid intake and dietary changes tailored to the type of stone and individual risk can reduce recurrence.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Urology
content: Shock wave lithotripsy uses externally generated shock waves to fragment selected urinary stones into smaller pieces that can pass through the urinary tract.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Urology
content: Ureteroscopy uses a small endoscope passed through the urinary tract to visualize and treat selected stones or other lesions.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Urology
content: Erectile dysfunction is difficulty getting or maintaining an erection sufficient for satisfactory sexual activity and can have vascular, neurologic, hormonal, medication-related, or psychological contributors.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Urology
content: Male infertility can result from problems with sperm production, sperm transport, ejaculation, hormones, genetics, or other reproductive factors.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Urology
content: A varicocele is enlargement of veins in the scrotum and may be associated with testicular discomfort, impaired sperm production, or infertility.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Urology
content: A hydrocele is an accumulation of fluid around a testicle that commonly causes painless scrotal swelling.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Urology
content: Testicular torsion occurs when the spermatic cord twists and reduces blood flow to the testis; it is a surgical emergency.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Urology
content: Epididymitis is inflammation of the epididymis and may cause scrotal pain and swelling, sometimes with urinary or infectious symptoms.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Urology
content: Prostatitis refers to inflammation or symptoms involving the prostate and includes several clinical syndromes with different causes.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Urology
content: Prostate cancer is a malignancy arising in prostate tissue and ranges from slow-growing disease to aggressive cancer.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Urology
content: Prostate-specific antigen is a protein produced by prostate cells; blood PSA testing can contribute to prostate cancer evaluation but is not specific for cancer.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Urology
content: Testicular cancer is a malignancy of the testis and is among the most common cancers in younger adult men.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Urology
content: Pelvic floor disorders can affect bladder and bowel control and may involve weakness or dysfunction of pelvic support structures.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Urology
content: Stress urinary incontinence is urine leakage associated with activities that increase abdominal pressure, such as coughing, sneezing, or exercise.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Urology
content: Urge urinary incontinence is leakage associated with a sudden compelling need to urinate and is commonly related to bladder overactivity.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Urology
content: Vesicoureteral reflux occurs when urine flows backward from the bladder toward the ureters and kidneys and can increase the risk of kidney infection.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Urology
content: Hypospadias is a congenital condition in which the urethral opening is located on the underside of the penis rather than at the usual tip.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Urology
content: An undescended testicle is a testis that has not moved into the scrotum before birth and may require evaluation because of effects on fertility and cancer risk.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Urology
content: Bladder cancer commonly begins in cells lining the bladder and may be classified according to invasion depth and tumor characteristics.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Urology
content: Kidney cancer includes several tumor types, with renal cell carcinoma being the most common kidney cancer in adults.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Urology
content: Urothelial cancers can arise in the lining of the renal pelvis and ureter and share biological features with bladder urothelial cancer.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Urology
content: Staging of urologic cancers describes the extent of disease and helps determine prognosis and treatment strategy.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Urology
content: Urinalysis evaluates urine appearance and chemical or microscopic findings and can provide clues about infection, blood, protein, glucose, and other abnormalities.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Urology
content: Urine culture can identify bacteria or other microorganisms causing urinary infection and can help guide antimicrobial selection.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Urology
content: Uroflowmetry measures the rate and pattern of urine flow and can help evaluate voiding dysfunction and obstruction.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Urology
content: Cystoscopy uses a thin instrument with a camera to examine the urethra and bladder and can help diagnose bleeding, tumors, stones, and other abnormalities.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Urology
content: Urodynamic tests assess how the bladder, sphincters, and urethra store and release urine.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Urology
content: Ultrasound can visualize the kidneys and urinary tract and can help evaluate obstruction, cysts, stones, and structural abnormalities.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Urology
content: Computed tomography can detect many urinary stones and assess their location and associated urinary obstruction.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Urology
content: PSA testing may contribute to prostate assessment, but PSA levels can be elevated for reasons other than cancer and require clinical interpretation.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Urology
content: Acute urinary retention is sudden inability to pass urine and can cause severe discomfort and require urgent bladder drainage and evaluation.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Urology
content: Urinary obstruction accompanied by infection can threaten kidney function and may require urgent drainage in addition to treatment of infection.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Urology
content: Visible blood in urine can arise from multiple urinary tract conditions and requires assessment, particularly when persistent or unexplained.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Urology
content: Testicular torsion requires urgent surgical evaluation because prolonged interruption of testicular blood flow can cause permanent testicular injury.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Urology
content: Urinary catheterization can provide bladder drainage in selected patients with urinary retention or other indications, with attention to infection and trauma risks.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Urology
content: Medicines for benign prostatic hyperplasia may relax prostate and bladder-neck smooth muscle or reduce prostate size depending on the drug class.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Urology
content: Procedures for benign prostatic hyperplasia can remove or reduce obstructing prostate tissue when symptoms are severe or insufficiently controlled medically.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Urology
content: Urinary stones may be managed with observation in selected cases or removed or fragmented using procedures depending on size, location, symptoms, obstruction, and clinical circumstances.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Urology
content: Treatment of urinary incontinence depends on the type and cause and may include behavioral measures, pelvic floor training, medicines, devices, or procedures.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Urology
content: Management of erectile dysfunction depends on its underlying causes and may include lifestyle measures, medicines, devices, counseling, or other interventions.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Urology
content: Urinary diversion reroutes urine through a surgically created pathway when normal urinary drainage is not possible or appropriate.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Urology
content: Urethral stricture is narrowing of the urethral lumen, often related to scar tissue, and can cause obstructive urinary symptoms.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Urology
content: Ureteropelvic junction obstruction is impaired urine drainage from the renal pelvis into the ureter and can cause hydronephrosis and kidney damage if significant.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Urology
content: Urologic care integrates symptoms, anatomy, kidney function, sexual and reproductive health, imaging, laboratory findings, procedural risks, and patient preferences.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.
